summary: Comprehensive testing of refactored router modules after server.py split. All 28 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend pages load correctly with proper navigation. The monolithic server.py (2924 lines) was successfully refactored into 8 modular routers + shared.py + slim server.py (~140 lines).
passed_tests: GET /api/ - root health check returns 200 with Rhino Drishti message
GET /api/dashboard/stats - returns total_items, critical_count, trend data
GET /api/intelligence - paginated list with 469 total items
GET /api/intelligence/{item_id} - single item detail returns correctly
GET /api/daily-brief - returns daily brief with key developments
GET /api/weekly-trends - returns 14 days of trend data
GET /api/keywords - returns 300 keywords with type breakdown
Frontend Dashboard loads with stat cards, threat map, alerts panel
Frontend Intelligence Feed page loads with 469 results
Frontend Knowledge Graph page loads with 113 actors, 21 locations
Frontend Daily Brief page loads with NER key developments
Frontend Keyword Engine page loads with 300 keywords
Frontend User Handbook page loads with complete documentation
critical_code_review_comments: Refactoring successfully split 2924-line server.py into 8 modular routers under /app/backend/routers/
shared.py correctly centralizes DB connections, models, constants, and utilities
All routers properly import from shared.py and maintain consistent patterns
WebSocket endpoint remains in server.py for proper lifecycle management
Scheduler functions imported from routers and initialized in server.py startup
CORS middleware correctly configured in server.py
All endpoints maintain /api/ prefix through router mounting
test_credentials: No credentials needed - app has no auth system
seed_data_creation: None - used existing data (469 intelligence items, 113 actors, 21 locations, 300 keywords)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Server.py refactoring complete and verified. The monolithic 2924-line server.py was split into: server.py (~140 lines - orchestrator), shared.py (shared state/models/utilities), and 8 router modules: intelligence.py (dashboard, CRUD, alerts, semantic search), settings.py (retention), briefs.py (daily brief, PDF, trends), pipeline.py (fetch, scrape, analyze), documents.py (upload), knowledge_graph_routes.py (KG endpoints), keywords_routes.py (keyword engine), sources.py (RSS, twitter, handbook). All 28 backend tests pass. All frontend pages load correctly. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_refactored_routers_v16.py
